read.en: Lumentum fell 3.0% on Oct 15 to $869.54 on volume 1.6 times its 20-day average and is down 17% in five sessions. It is below its 5-day ($970.5), 10-day ($1,032.3), 30-day ($964.0) and 100-day ($875.8) averages and above the 200-day ($775.2). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 13 and is above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($1,120.9), and RSI is 40.5.
read.zh: Lumentum 10月15日下跌 3.0%，收于 $869.54，成交量为 20 日均量的 1.6 倍，五个交易日下跌 17%。股价位于 5 日（$970.5）、10 日（$1,032.3）、30 日（$964.0）和 100 日均线（$875.8）下方，并在 200 日均线（$775.2）上方。MACD 于 10月13日下穿信号线，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$1,120.9），RSI 为 40.5。

read.en: The $876–881 support (100-day average and Sep 28 low) broke on the close and is now first resistance, then $964–971 (30 and 5-day averages) and $1,007 (September shelf). The day's low of $800 undercut the Sep 15 ($832) and Sep 3 ($819) lows before the close recovered above them. A close below $819 would reopen $800; a close back above $881 would target $964.
read.zh: $876–881 支撑（100 日均线及 9月28日低点）收盘失守，现转为第一阻力，其次 $964–971（30 日和 5 日均线）和 $1,007（9月平台）。当日低点 $800 曾跌破 9月15日（$832）和 9月3日（$819）低点，随后收盘收回其上方。若收盘跌破 $819，将再度打开至 $800 的空间；若收盘重新站上 $881，目标看 $964。

r.en: 100-day average and Sep 28 low ($876–881), now resistance
r.zh: 100日均线及9月28日低点（$876–881），转为阻力
